answer: Beacon-decay bond: each identity locks 450 credits in a prism seal. Each epoch a beacon pulse sweeps the registry; the identity answers with its key, and a mirror copy is filed. One miss decays it 10%, burning 45 credits; two misses burn it all, forcing a fresh voyage. 1,000 fakes lock 450,000, bleeding 45,000 per idle epoch against a 40,000 pool. Rented pulses fail: a borrowed key mismatches the seal. An honest agent pays 450 once and keeps it.
